RC10.1 repairs the shared Python parser used by source and comment checks. Valid conditional
expressions, lambdas and unnamed exception handlers now reach normal governance policy instead
of failing AST encoding. Both captured current source and historical before-images use the repair.

Declaration bounds, docstrings, decorators and existing complexity metrics are preserved.
Invalid current-source syntax, malformed AST output and unavailable or failed parsers still block.
Invalid historical syntax keeps the existing unavailable symbol comparison. This is a
parser repair, with no comment waiver, configuration change or JEV selection change.

Proof covers generic parser regressions, the compiled suite and the installed archive, including
current/before-image comment enforcement. It does not establish new device behavior or token savings.

Upgrade deliberately at a pause seam in each execution worktree. Installing this hotfix does not
upgrade sibling pins, enable JEV, align a chat attached to another checkout or tune retrieval limits.
